pad_image_to_factor_basic: pad a PyTorch image tensor so its height and width are divisible by a given factor
pad_image_to_factor_reflect: pad an image tensor using reflect mode to make dimensions divisible by a downsampling factor
pad_image_to_factor_autoencoder: pad input images before feeding them into a neural autoencoder to avoid dimension mismatch
pad_image_to_factor_original_dims: pad an image tensor and retrieve its original height and width for later cropping
pad_image_to_factor_custom_mode: pad an image tensor with a custom padding mode like replicate to match a target factor
